tips_en: Start with ASI-Bench (Paper 3) — its B1–B4 guidance gradient provides the sharpest lens on where current AI systems actually break down, revealing that method operationalization, not method selection, is the real bottleneck. Then read StateM (Paper 2), which offers a concrete infrastructure response to exactly the kind of long-horizon failures ASI-Bench exposes, showing how harness-level state management can lift agent accuracy by 9–12 points. SA-MRPO (Paper 1) is the most self-contained and can be read independently if your focus is on training-time optimization rather than agent evaluation.
tips_zh: 建议先读ASI-Bench（论文3）——其B1–B4引导梯度设计提供了最清晰的视角，揭示当前AI系统的真正瓶颈是方法落地执行而非方法选择。接着读StateM（论文2），它针对ASI-Bench所暴露的长程失败提出了具体的基础设施级解决方案，通过状态机运行时将代理准确率提升9–12个百分点。SA-MRPO（论文1）较为独立，若你更关注训练阶段优化而非代理评估，可单独阅读。
